question: In Table 1, what carrier does NCP-CD47 siRNA use, which institution runs its trial, and what is the trial's status?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, row_no, col_no, text FROM cells WHERE table_id='p2.T1' AND row_no IN (SELECT row_no FROM cells WHERE table_id='p2.T1' AND text ILIKE '%CD47%') ORDER BY row_no, col_no
SELECT id, row_no, col_no, text FROM cells WHERE table_id='p2.T1' AND row_no BETWEEN 19 AND 23 ORDER BY row_no, col_no
SELECT id, line_no, text, x0 FROM lines WHERE page=2 AND text ILIKE ANY (ARRAY['%non-%','%cationic%','%peptide%','%conjugate%','%Ligand%','%CD47%','%Not yet%']) ORDER BY top

SELECT id, text, x0, top FROM lines WHERE page=2 AND (text ILIKE '%non-%' OR text ILIKE '%cationic%' OR text ILIKE '%peptide%' OR text ILIKE '%conjugate%' OR text ILIKE '%CD47%' OR text ILIKE '%Not yet%' OR text ILIKE '%nanocarrier%') ORDER BY top
SELECT id, kind, page, text FROM atoms WHERE text ILIKE '%cationic%' OR text ILIKE '%NCP-CD47%' OR text ILIKE '%West China%'
SELECT id, text FROM atoms WHERE page=3 AND kind='line' AND id IN ('p3.L6','p3.L7','p3.L8','p3.L9','p3.L10','p3.L11')
